output.subject: We've received your message about your escrow analysis
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us, and for setting out your concerns so clearly. We have received your complaint.

You told us that you first raised this through the complaint form on our website on September 18 and have not heard back, so you are now following up by email. We understand how frustrating it is to wait without a reply, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

As you describe it, your escrow analysis dated 9/7 uses $11,840.00 for property taxes, while the town's bill is $8,120. You mentioned that, in your view, this difference accounts for the entire $742.50 shortage shown on the analysis. You have asked us to correct the analysis using the actual tax bill before your new payment of $1,974.28 takes effect.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If you have anything further you would like us to consider, you are welcome to reply to this email.

Thank you for your patience.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check when the new $1,974.28 payment takes effect; it may start before the 10-business-day response window ends.
Find the customer's September 18 website complaint and confirm whether it was received and why there was no reply.
Compare the property tax figure on the 9/7 escrow analysis with the town's current tax bill.
Decide whether to ask the customer for a copy of the town's tax bill.
Decide what the customer should do about the upcoming payment while the review is open.
The draft does not promise a correction, a recalculation or any payment change. Add any outcome only after it has been decided.
